title: Campanato estimate for the slope Df (parent step 5; Simon 5.(11))
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, U, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with W open and W ⊆ U, R ∈ IMRep U n, μ := R.measure, M := R.carrier, κ ∈ ℝ, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ ¼|v − w| and f(0) = 0, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, a > 0, s₀ > 0, K ∈ ℝ, Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'f(v), Df := fderiv ℝ f, graph Df(v) := range(ι + ι'∘Df(v)), p_x the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, and |A|² := Σ_i |Ae_i|² (standard basis). Assume (hP) x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. strongly measurable; (hdens) unitBallVolume n ≤ (e^{κt}/tⁿ)μ(B_t(y)) for y ∈ spt μ, t > 0, B_t(y) ⊆ W; (hnull) Hⁿ((spt μ ∩ W) ∖ M) = 0; (htan) for Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ W)-a.e. x and every v with x = Φ(v), f is differentiable at v and approxTangentPlane n M x = graph Df(v); B_a(z) ⊆ W; spt μ ∩ B_a(z) = Φ(ℝⁿ) ∩ B_a(z); and for every ξ ∈ spt μ ∩ B_a(z) there is an n-dimensional subspace S with ∫_{B_s(ξ)}|p_x − p_S|²dμ ≤ ofReal(Ks^{n+1}) for all s ∈ (0, s₀]. Then there are C ≥ 0 and s₁ > 0 such that for Lⁿ-a.e. v with |v| < a/2, f is differentiable at v and ∫_{B̆ⁿ_s(v)} |Df(w) − Df(v)|² dw ≤ ofReal(Cs^{n+1}) for every s ∈ (0, s₁].
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (κ : ℝ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (a s₀ K : ℝ), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → (∀ y ∈ R.measure.support, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → closedBall y t ⊆ W → unitBallVolume n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y t)) → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ W)), ∀ v : Euclid n, x = z + ι v + ι' (f v) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x = LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ f v).toLinearMap)) → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 * ‖v - w‖) → f 0 = 0 → 0 < a → 0 < s₀ → closedBall z a ⊆ W → R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z a = range (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (f v)) ∩ closedBall z a → (∀ ξ ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z a, ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ S = n ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * s ^ (n + 1))) → ∃ C s₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < s₁ ∧ ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) (a / 2) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₁ → ∫⁻ w in ball v s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin n, ‖(fderiv ℝ f w - fderiv ℝ f v) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * s ^ (n + 1))
